data.spec: PR 6 (stacked on PR 4). POST /api/requests/{id}/reject -> request view; 409 unless status is awaiting_approval, or if execution was attempted. No model call. A finished proposal with no order now returns status resolved with supplier_reference null. Critical reports with no item now create a local tickets row, so they return intent maintenance and status maintenance_open and can be closed with /resolve. Dashboard: a ticket is any request with non-null intent; other requests stay in chat. The Desk view is gone; chat is AgentChat.tsx in AgentStage.
